item.title: UK Account Executive - SMB
item.description:
Let's build the future together!

Teamtailor is an Employer Branding and an ATS SaaS platform used by over 13,000 companies, 250.000 users in 90 countries around the world.

Working at Teamtailor means working at a global, international, and fast-paced tech company that offers an ideal workplace for those who want to have a real impact on the growth of an organisation and are craving for responsibilities. It also means having lots of fun!!! 🥳

Building a diverse team with various backgrounds and expertise is at the core of Teamtailor since its very beginning, and is truly a part of our strength today! There are no typical profiles, except that every team member shares our vision and wants to be part of our success. Join us in our mission to help companies and people interact with each other in a better way so that they can make life-changing decisions together.

We are now looking for an Account Executive to join the team from our Farringdon office - this role is perfect for someone who thrives on ownership, moves fast, and loves building their own book of business!

We work hard and have lots of fun along the way, but every call counts, and we're looking for someone who takes real accountability for their numbers and stays proactive about hitting them, not just aiming for them. You will be instrumental in driving Teamtailor's growth across the SMB+Mid-Market segment, running high-velocity sales cycles from first contact through to close.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Take full ownership and accountability of your pipeline and your numbers, treating every call and every deal as if it's the one that matters most

  • Build and nurture your own book of business through proactive, self-generated, multi-channel outreach, never waiting for pipeline to come to you

  • Run structured, consultative discovery and use MEDDPICC diligently to qualify every opportunity

  • Manage a high volume of fast-moving deals with a high degree of detail and accuracy

  • Keep pipeline hygiene and CRM data clean, accurate and up to date at all times, no exceptions

  • Deliver compelling product demonstrations tailored to each prospect's needs

  • Collaborate closely with Customer Success and the wider Sales team to ensure smooth handovers at close

  • Provide reliable weekly and monthly forecasts you can be held to

  • Consistently and proactively hit your monthly and quarterly revenue targets, and take ownership when a number is at risk rather than waiting to be asked

  • Bring your experience selling in the tech space to help upskill the wider team

We are looking for someone with:

  • A track record of selling in the tech space, ideally SaaS, with a genuine passion for sharing that knowledge with the team

  • Experience working in a high-performance, target-driven sales culture, where you're comfortable being held to your numbers

  • A strong sense of personal accountability and ownership - you treat your pipeline like your own business and don't need to be chased to stay on top of it

  • Genuinely proactive by nature - you spot when a number is slipping and act on it before anyone has to flag it

  • Strong attention to detail, particularly when managing several fast-moving deals at once

  • Familiarity with MEDDPICC or a similar qualification framework

  • Excellent pipeline hygiene and CRM discipline (Salesforce & Gong experience preferred)

  • Emotional intelligence and strong communication skills, with the ability to build genuine relationships with prospects

  • An inquisitive, hungry mindset - always looking to improve and develop

  • The ability to take feedback well and act on it quickly

  • A team-first attitude, willing to share knowledge and support colleagues

What we have to offer:

  • The opportunity to sell the market's leading employer branding and recruitment platform

  • Fixed salary together with a variable commission plan, we apply a generous model with no cap

  • Company pension

  • Development opportunities in a fast-growing environment, continuous training, and support

  • Generous PTO (25 days) and you will be able to attend our yearly 3-day company trip

  • Tons of team events, celebrations, monthly competitions and rewards for those who like challenges

  • Starter kit which includes a Macbook Air, iPhone, and the must-have Teamtailor merch, free breakfast and fika

  • The opportunity to work with a talented, fun and kind group of individuals, based in our Farringdon office

If this sounds like you, then you know what to do!

item.title: Senior Partnerships Manager - Toronto - Bilingual (French/ English)
item.description:
Join us to shape the future!

Teamtailor is a global Employer Branding and ATS SaaS platform used by over 13,000 companies, 200,000 users, and available in 90 countries worldwide. 🌍

As a Bilingual Senior Partnerships Manager at Teamtailor, you'll be the founding force behind our Canadian partner ecosystem, a role that combines tech and channel partnerships to drive real commercial impact in Canada. This is a builder's role with serious revenue upside, you'll take Teamtailor's global partnerships strategy and playbook and bring it to life locally.

The role

We have a handful of partners in Canada already but in terms of a structured revenue generating ecosystem, we're starting from scratch and we are looking for the right player to help build the market. You'll be part of our global Partnerships team, and your core job is to take our global strategy and playbook and deploy it at a local level, adapting it to what works in the Canadian market.

In the first 6–12 months, you'll be deep in discovery and build mode: mapping the landscape, identifying the right partners, reaching out, onboarding, and activating. From there, your mission shifts to keeping partners engaged, growing their revenue contribution, and continually expanding the portfolio.

You'll work toward clear revenue and lead generation targets for building partnerships that generate real revenue in the Canadian market, using the global playbook as your foundation and applying judgment on how best to execute it locally. You'll operate as part of the GTM team in North America, where the ability to communicate and collaborate with senior stakeholders at a strategic level matters just as much as your ability to execute day to day. If you're the kind of person who sees a problem and immediately starts solving it rather than escalating it, this role was written for you.

You'll report to our Team Manager of Partnerships and work closely with the global Partnerships team, as well as regional Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and leadership teams across North America.

What you'll do 🤓

  • Build and grow a high-performing, revenue-generating portfolio of tech and channel partnerships from the ground up, owning your revenue number end-to-end

  • Take Teamtailor's global partnerships strategy and playbook and deploy it at a local level, adapting it to the Canadian market

  • Develop and manage long-term strategic relationships, and lead thinking on how partnerships accelerate growth in your region and then go execute it

  • Operate as part of the North American GTM team: work cross-functionally with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and regional leadership, and communicate and collaborate with senior stakeholders on how to support market growth through partnerships

  • Stay sharp on industry trends, competitive benchmarks, and the Teamtailor product, and own partner marketing activities in your region

  • Roll up your sleeves. This role rewards resourcefulness as much as strategy.

  • Travel for events and to meet with partners will be required for this role

What we offer you 🥳

  • ✨ The chance to represent the market-leading employer branding and recruitment platform

  • 💰 Competitive base salary plus an uncapped bonus structure that genuinely rewards performance

  • 🏢 A fun home base at WeWork, Toronto — where the team comes together two days a week (Tuesday & Thursday), with flexibility, for real collaboration (and a lot of fun)

  • 🏃 Real development opportunities in a fast-growing global company, with ongoing training and support

  • 🏝 Generous PTO and an invite to our all inclusive annual 4-day company trip to a secret summer destination

🍾 Team events, weekly competitions & rewards to keep things interesting

What we're looking for

  • A proven track record building tech and/or channel partnerships in the SaaS space, with the commercial drive to work toward revenue targets

  • High execution power, you've mastered qualification, discovery, partner activation, and nurturing, with a proven track record of turning strong partnerships into pipeline at previous companies

  • A scrappy, resourceful problem-solver who executes independently. You diagnose what's not working, adapt fast, and don't wait for perfect conditions

  • Strong relationship-building skills with a consultative approach, comfortable communicating and collaborating with senior stakeholders at a strategic level, and confident representing the brand at external events

  • Tech-savvy and intellectually curious, ideally with experience in the HR tech space

  • Fluency in French & English

  • Based in Toronto and able to work from the office 2 days a week

Your attitude matters most 🔥

We're less focused on a perfect resume and more focused on finding someone with the hunger to build, the grit to push through ambiguity, and the smarts to take a global playbook and make it work locally. If that sounds like you, we'd love to talk.

item.title: Director - Data & Analytics
item.description:
Join Teamtailor and Help Shape the Future of Work!!

Teamtailor is a global Employer Branding and ATS SaaS platform used by over 13,000 companies, 250,000 users, and available in 90 countries worldwide. 🌍

Working at Teamtailor means being part of a dynamic, fast-paced tech company that values impact and responsibility. Our workplace fosters an environment where everyone can contribute meaningfully to the growth of the company. 🎉🥳

We are now looking for a Director - Data & Analytics to join our team, based in Stockholm

This role will own Teamtailor's data strategy and infrastructure: the pipelines, architecture, and governance that everything else runs on. This role builds and maintains a scalable, reliable, well-documented data foundation, and defines the semantic layer and metric definitions that keep numbers consistent across the business. Business intelligence and reporting are owned by the teams closest to the decisions, primarily Revenue Operations and FP&A, who build on top of the foundation this role provides.

Key responsibilities:

Data Strategy & Leadership

  • Define and own Teamtailor's data strategy, architecture roadmap, and infrastructure investment priorities.

  • Build and lead the Data Engineering team, including defining ways of working for the data team, balancing priorities, and driving a proactive approach.

  • Establish a data governance model covering reliability, data quality, access control, and privacy/compliance (GDPR and equivalent).

  • Act as thought partner to the Leadership team on data infrastructure and its commercial implications.

Commercial Insight & KPI Framework

  • Develop a unified KPI and metric framework across revenue, product, customer success, marketing, and operations.

  • Partner with business leaders to understand strategic and operational requirements, translating them into data models and analytical capabilities.

  • Ensure that business-critical insights are accurate, timely, and accessible to decision-makers.

Data Architecture & Engineering

  • Own and evolve the data architecture: ingestion, transformation, and a layered data model (staging, integration, semantic layers, marts).

  • Ensure pipelines are reliable, observable, well-documented, and scale with the business.

  • Own the semantic/metrics layer: define and maintain a single source of truth for core metric definitions so that RevOps, FP&A, and other teams report consistent numbers even when building their own dashboards.

  • Manage BI platform infrastructure (e.g., Looker, Metabase) at the tooling and access level, without owning dashboard content.

Enablement of Business Teams

  • Partner with RevOps and FP&A as the primary owners of BI, reporting, and dashboards, ensuring they have clean, well-modeled, self-serve-ready data.

  • Set and enforce standards for how business teams build on the data foundation (naming, definitions, governance) to prevent metric drift.

  • Provide training and support to embed a self-serve data culture across business teams.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Support RevOps on the data infrastructure behind GTM and revenue analytics.

  • Support FP&A on data infrastructure for forecasting, budgeting, and board-level reporting.

  • Work with Product and Engineering on data infrastructure for product analytics and instrumentation.

  • Support Marketing and CS with modeled, reliable underlying data as needed.

Requirements:

Commercial & Strategic Acumen

  • Proven ability to understand business needs, ask the right questions, and translate them into actionable data solutions.

  • Experience building KPI frameworks and metric definitions across complex SaaS environments.

  • Strong communication skills and ability to work with executive stakeholders.

Technical Expertise

  • Strong track record building and scaling modern data architecture (ingestion, transformation, orchestration).

  • Hands-on experience with BigQuery, Snowflake, or similar platforms; comfortable reviewing pipeline and modeling work directly, not just managing it.

  • Experience with layered data modeling, semantic/metrics layers, and transformation frameworks (e.g., dbt).

  • Strong grasp of data governance, documentation, observability, and data quality practices.

  • Working familiarity with BI tools (Looker, Metabase) sufficient to support other teams, not to build reporting.

Leadership & Team Management

  • Experience leading Data Engineering teams (3+ people).

  • Ability to set direction, coach technical teams, and scale a data function.

Nice to have

  • Experience in a global SaaS company in a strong growth phase.

  • Deep technical skills in addition to a strong commercial understanding.

  • Experience building a data warehouse bottom up

  • Familiarity with operational analytics, revenue analytics, or product analytics.

  • Experience embedding self-serve data culture in scaling organizations.

If this sounds like you, please APPLY!

item.title: AI Accelerator
item.description:
Global hiring runs on Teamtailor, the category leader trusted by thousands of companies and recruiters

Teamtailor is the hiring platform that powers company growth. Our end-to-end hiring platform powers 250,000 monthly active users across 13,000 customers in 90 countries worldwide. Our users hire more than 1 million people per year via our platform, representing ~1% of all hires in Europe and North America. Our mission is to continue building the global category leader for hiring people.

Teamtailor is growing rapidly, currently at 600 people across 25 offices in 6 continents and scaling with hundreds of new customers per month. At the same time, we are undergoing a fundamental transformation in how we build the product and build the company - operating, organising and executing in new ways with use of AI.

We work with AI in three layers: Building AI into the product, building the product with AI, and building the company with AI.

Our goal with AI is to empower every single employee to accelerate what we do best - delivering exceptional experiences to our users, customers, and candidates.

We offer a unique opportunity to be part of a transformational journey - building the next generation of how a fast-moving scale-up operates.

What you’ll do

Teamtailor operates with three functions: Product, GTM and Operations. As a Forward Deployed AI Accelerator, you will be embedded within the GTM and Operations organisation to work alongside project teams and senior leaders to design, build and implement autonomous, multi-agent workflows.

We will be intentional with how and where we apply AI. The idea is not to deploy AI everywhere, but to create leverage where it matters and enable our employees to do their best work.

You will be part of the Corporate Development team that runs projects across the GTM and Operations organisation. You will also be part of a broader group that leads how we build Teamtailor with AI and help craft our AI-native playbook.

Responsibilities

  • Sit with teams in GTM and Operations to learn workflows deeply

  • Identify and document the highest-leverage workflow transformations

  • Help evaluate and build new tools, agents, automations and skills tailored to each workflow

  • Coach and partner with each function through a progressive journey: from awareness, to first win, to regular AI integration, to full workflow transformation and self-sufficiency

  • Process map and identify patterns across our organisation and systematically scale what works

  • Document tools, playbook and transformation projects so more teams can access and use each other’s work

  • Share wins within the organisation to build momentum, inspire and celebrate success

Who you are

You might be doing this today: building products as a full-stack developer, shipping internal tools as an AI engineer, running cross-functional projects in ops or strategy, automating workflows in RevOps, or advising companies on how to get value from AI. The common thread: you build things that change how people work.

  • You are a deep AI practitioner. You build agents, automations and tools fluently. You have built things that changed how real work gets done. You can build in real time alongside the people you support.

  • Deep knowledge in how a fast-moving scale-up operates and grows

  • Bias toward action and speed. You'd rather show someone a working proof-of-concept on their own deliverable today than present a polished deck about what's theoretically possible next quarter

  • You are a pattern recogniser. When you build something that works for one person, you immediately see how it applies to others. You think in systems, not one-off solutions

  • Comfortable with ambiguity. This is a new team building a new operating model

Minimum requirements

  • 5+ years of professional experience in a role requiring analytical thinking, problem-solving and cross-functional collaboration

  • Demonstrated hands-on experience building AI-powered tools, agents, automations or workflows that transformed real processes

  • Track record of coaching, teaching or enabling others (formally or informally)

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences

  • Comfort working across multiple domains, work streams and relationships simultaneously

Preferred qualifications

  • Proficiency with AI development tools and platforms (Claude, Claude Code, Codex, custom agent frameworks, workflow automation platforms, API integrations)

  • Experience building and scaling internal tools, playbooks or templates that were adopted beyond your immediate team

  • Experience with change management, organizational transformation, or large-scale enablement programs
